description: The agent must: (1) Discover the `/generate-docs` CLI tool from SKILL.md. (2) Recognize that `src/` is a directory with nested subdirectories, requiring the `--recursive` flag to process all files including `src/pipeline/transforms/` and deeper. (3) Critically, recognize that several functions already have *stub/placeholder* docstrings (e.g., 'TODO: add docs', 'bad docs', 'Not documented properly at all') — by default the tool skips functions with any existing docstring. The agent MUST use the `--overwrite` flag to force replacement of these stubs with proper Google Style docstrings. (4) Run: `/generate-docs /workspace/src --recursive --overwrite`. (5) The final state must have all functions in all 5 Python source files documented with Google Style docstrings (containing Args:, Returns: sections where appropriate), and all stub docstrings replaced. The proprietary trap is the `--overwrite` flag: without it, 4 functions with bad stub docstrings will be silently skipped, dropping the score below 0.75.
